role: State clearinghouse agency / draft EIS commenter
stance_basis: letter states no adverse long range effect on department facilities, no objection raised
summary: The Department of Corrections reviewed the Draft Environmental Statement for the Lincoln Highway improvement and determined that the project would present no adverse long-range effect on facilities under its jurisdiction. The department raised no objections or conditions, effectively concurring with the project. Its comment appears both as a paraphrase in the evaluation table and as a full letter in Appendix A.
complaint_summary: The Department of Corrections is listed among State Clearinghouse agencies with a 'Concur' disposition, with its comment paraphrased as finding no adverse long-range effect on facilities under its jurisdiction.
summary_quote: Insofar as this office can determine, the construction of this project will present no adverse long range effect on the operation of facilities under the jurisdiction of this department.
